newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was fixed weaker against the dollar and steady against sterling, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a commercial mean rate of 21.5375 to the dollar from 21.485 on Tuesday and at 35.1035 against the pound from 35.0955 on Tuesday.
Forex dealers said the central bank was seen selling dollars in the forex interbank market on Tuesday mid- afternoon at a price slightly above the prevailing interbank rate.
